What's on the van

Everything is served fresh from the hatch. Mix and match to build the menu that fits your guests.

Soft serve cones

Classic 99 with a flake, waffle cones, twins and sherbet dips.

Waffle lolly

Crispy waffle on a stick, dipped in chocolate or Nutella.

Nutella crêpes

Cooked live on the hot plate and folded warm with Nutella.

Banana chocolate

Fresh banana slices with melted chocolate inside a golden crêpe.

Lemon & sugar

The British favourite: fresh lemon and a snow of sugar.

Kinder Bueno shake

Thick, creamy and loaded with crushed Bueno pieces.

Milkshakes

Oreo, Biscoff, strawberry, banana and chocolate.

Sundaes & glories

Tubs, boat sundaes and glories with sauce and a flake.

Four Seasons Ice Cream is a London ice cream and crêpe van built for celebrations. The name says it all: we serve in every season, from summer weddings to winter birthday parties.

We bring everything with us: the van, the machines, the toppings and a friendly team. You choose the menu and the time, we handle the rest and leave the place spotless.
